policy.ordinary_homelands: Explicit historical core areas, translated through checked location-to-state links. Neither 20% settlement nor a present majority automatically establishes a homeland. Record historical period, evidence and coarse-state limitations separately.
policy.campaign_continuity: Historical evidence informs identity and geography; it never deletes surviving campaign cultures, changes population religion, or moves people back to real-world homelands.
policy.migrant_homelands: Keep the user-selected strictly greater than 50% of the whole output state; preserve indigenous homelands.
policy.heritage: A V3 acceptance design, not a taxonomic fact. Document the historical evidence and the gameplay inference separately; language family alone cannot justify identity merging.
policy.review: Review identity, language, heritage design, historical geography, state translation, names and appearance independently. No asset is fully historically reviewed merely because its identity split is supported.
policy.budget: This bounded candidate adds five used cultures (400 to 405); resident assets remain below 100 and effective definitions below 480. No return to one asset per source identity.

azeri_iranica.title: AZERBAIJAN vii. The Iranian Language of Azerbaijan — Ehsan Yarshater
azeri_iranica.scope: Historical Iranian Adhari, its retreat with Turkic expansion, and surviving related dialects; not a claim that all Azerbaijan was Adhari in 1780.

astara_iranica.title: ĀSTĀRĀ i. Town and sub-province — Marcel Bazin
astara_iranica.scope: Talyshi khans of Astara in the sixteenth to eighteenth centuries; later descriptions must not be projected unchanged into 1780.

talysh_glottolog.title: Glottolog 5.3: North-Central Talysh
talysh_glottolog.scope: Distinct modern linguistic record; does not delimit all historical Talysh settlement.

pamir_iranica.title: CENTRAL ASIA xiii. Iranian Languages — I. M. Steblin-Kamenskij
pamir_iranica.scope: Pamir languages are several Eastern Iranian languages, distinct from Perso-Tajik; not a single language or synonymous with Pashto.

sarikol_iranica.title: CHINESE TURKESTAN vi. Iranian Groups in Sinkiang since the 1750s — Kim Ho-Dong
sarikol_iranica.scope: Late seventeenth to nineteenth century eastern Pamir settlement; distinguish Sarikol/Lake Zorkul geographical names and do not equate the whole Tian Shan with Pamir homelands.

bone_chronicle.title: The Bugis Chronicle of Bone — Macknight, Paeni and Hadrawi (eds.), ANU Press, 2020
bone_chronicle.scope: Edition of a late-seventeenth-century chronicle: Bone and Makasar Gowa have distinct political traditions and sustained interaction in South Sulawesi.

bugis_glottolog.title: Glottolog 5.3: Buginese
bugis_glottolog.scope: Bugis linguistic identity, separate from Makasar.

makasar_glottolog.title: Glottolog 5.3: Makasar
makasar_glottolog.scope: Makasar linguistic identity, separate from Bugis.

hadza_glottolog.title: Glottolog 5.3: Hadza
hadza_glottolog.scope: Hadza has independent classification; click consonants do not establish a shared Khoisan family.

sandawe_glottolog.title: Glottolog 5.3: Sandawe
sandawe_glottolog.scope: Sandawe has independent classification in this catalogue. Hypothesized more distant relations are not treated as established here.

hadza_ethnography.title: Frank Marlowe, The Hadza: Hunter-Gatherers of Tanzania, UC Press, 2010
hadza_ethnography.scope: Ethnographic orientation near Serengeti/Olduvai. Publisher description alone is insufficient for an exact eighteenth-century territorial boundary.

sandawe_phonetics.title: Sandawe — Journal of the International Phonetic Association
sandawe_phonetics.scope: Modern Kondoa-area linguistic description; supports geographic orientation, not an unqualified 1780 homeland boundary.

adhari_culture.identity_basis: 保留战役中仍存续的伊朗语阿扎里身份，不与突厥语阿塞拜疆人等同，也不因现实历史中的衰退删除人口。

language.basis: 保留伊朗语阿扎里；与塔雷什语区分，使用原版伊朗语言组。

heritage.basis: 候选玩法设计：在伊朗历史文化背景及原版 Persian/Tajik 传承粒度下共享伊朗传承；文化与语言仍独立，接纳平衡待游戏内评估。

homeland.period: Medieval core with survival in the alternate 1780 campaign
homeland.region: 伊朗阿塞拜疆的大不里士历史核心
homeland.limitation: 只先纳入有证据的核心州；不把伊朗全境或整个高加索列入。此处延续战役身份，不声称1780现实大不里士仍以阿扎里语为主。

talysh_culture.identity_basis: 塔雷什作为里海西南沿岸身份单列；阿斯塔拉的16—18世纪塔雷什汗历史提供时段相关证据。

language.basis: 源游戏写作 adharic_language，目标显式区分塔雷什语；更细方言不另造文化。

heritage.basis: 候选玩法设计：塔雷什—吉兰—阿尔达比勒的历史联系及原版伊朗传承粒度支持共享大类；不合并为波斯或阿扎里文化。

homeland.region: 阿斯塔拉—兰卡兰与塔雷什山地沿岸核心
homeland.limitation: V3 州包括大量非塔雷什区域；州级本土表示核心聚居区与该州相交，不表示全州族群同质或领土主权。

pamiri_culture.identity_basis: 从伊朗其他诸族中分离帕米尔诸族，内部保留V3可用的山地集合粒度，不进一步细分每条山谷。

language.basis: 纠正源 afghani_language 的过宽归类；帕米尔诸语言是东伊朗语的若干语言，集合标签不声称其为单一语言。

heritage.basis: 候选玩法设计：借用原版伊朗传承容纳帕米尔历史身份及与波斯—塔吉克文化空间的联系；与塔吉克文化、波斯语均保持区分。

homeland.region: 巴达赫尚、瓦罕及帕米尔山谷
homeland.limitation: 战役人口只在 sarikol，现有转换落到 TIANSHAN。须复核历史 Sarikol/Zorkul 与源地点坐标，以及塔吉克、阿富汗和新疆州边界；不因现居天山就自动授予整个天山本土。

buginese_culture.identity_basis: Bone 编年史及独立布吉语证据支持布吉与望加锡分别保留；其他苏拉威西群体不冒用布吉名称。

language.basis: 独立布吉语特质，使用原版南岛语言组。

heritage.basis: 候选玩法设计：南苏拉威西的历史互动置于原版 Malay/Moluccan 所用群岛传承；不把群岛传承当成共同民族。

homeland.period: Fourteenth to seventeenth centuries, continuing into eighteenth century
homeland.region: 南苏拉威西 Bone 等布吉核心区
homeland.limitation: V3 把苏拉威西放在一个州；CELEBES 是州级近似，海外少量布吉人口不自动生成本土。

makassarese_culture.identity_basis: Gowa 与 Bone 具有独立政治传统；望加锡语与布吉语分别记录。

language.basis: 覆盖源 buginese_language 的粗糙字段，独立目标语言保持来源字段不变。

heritage.basis: 候选玩法设计：与布吉共享原版群岛传承，体现南苏拉威西历史互动；各自保留文化和语言。

homeland.period: Sixteenth to seventeenth centuries, continuing into eighteenth century
homeland.region: 南苏拉威西 Gowa—Tallo 核心
homeland.limitation: 与布吉共享州级本土不等于二者历史疆域或民族相同。

hadza_culture.identity_basis: 不能因点击音或源 khoisan_group 就将哈扎与桑达韦视为同族；先保留两种文化。

language.basis: 依现有分类独立建组；不沿用源 khoe_language，也不据此推断其他点击音语言的亲缘。

heritage.basis: 候选保守设计：独立哈扎传承放在原版非洲大组，暂不强制共享科伊桑或班图传承；这不是血统分类。

homeland.period: Modern ethnographic orientation; eighteenth-century extent unresolved
homeland.region: 埃亚西湖周边、坦桑尼亚北部
homeland.limitation: 现代民族志概览不足以划定1780范围；须补充时段证据并核对 TANGANYIKA/邻州位置，不能取全部当前人口州。

sandawe_culture.identity_basis: 独立桑达韦身份及语言；不把尚有争议的远亲语言假说变成已证实的共同传承。

language.basis: 独立桑达韦语言组，保持远亲关系未定；与哈扎语分开。

heritage.basis: 候选保守设计：独立桑达韦传承置于原版非洲大组；不以音系特点推断与哈扎的共同民族身份。

homeland.period: Modern Kondoa distribution; eighteenth-century extent unresolved
homeland.region: 坦桑尼亚中部 Kondoa 一带
homeland.limitation: 源地点跨两个目标州；现代语言地点不能直接证明两州全应为1780本土，补历史地图后再确认。

next_priority.issue: 库希特其他诸族包含 Gonga、Ometo 等奥摩相关群体；需独立考察，不能沿用旧名称声称同一语支。
核查 Ijaw 与所谓 Volta-Niger 集合的关系；文化圈、语言分支与现居范围须分开。
Totonac、Mixe-Zoque 与 Ikoot/Huave 的集合关系需重审。
Nuristani、Pashayi、Shina 等不能仅凭印度地区标签当成同一民族。
Lenca 与 Misumalpan 的关系须核实；先保留明确来源，不提前认定亲缘。
集合跨印度、东南亚大陆与岛屿；南亚语系不能代替共同历史文化圈。
